description: Identify the HonkIO account this connection acts on: the account (ID, name, credit balance, status), its list of API keys (each with its own prefix, mode and label), and caller. caller.mode is this connection's mode, TEST or LIVE; caller.oauth_client is the client an OAuth connection was granted to (id and name), and null on an API key. It does not say which listed key is the calling one. An older API leaves caller out, and then the mode is not reported. Returns the account ID the account tools take.
name: whoami
title: Who am I
